name: proofline
description: BUILD-020 Proofline — a standalone single-process local service that lets Warwick paste text under a key and PROVE BY EXECUTION that the submission was fsynced before he was acknowledged, that a background worker (not the request thread) processed it, that the analysis is a pure deterministic function of the text, that it stops for his approval, and that a job caught mid-flight by an abrupt kill comes back and finishes exactly once. Zero npm dependencies; Node 22 stdlib only. Loopback bind only; no network egress.
